exact_missing_items: Gap: provider/model settings are not yet defined at node, work package, feature seam, work package overseer, and delegated-subagent levels — this gap must be filled before schemas can be finalized
Gemini: chat is still single-threaded with no multi-lane overseer routing — the design must define how multiple overseer lanes communicate via chat
PM-owned SCM state is not fully visible: managed template repos, active git operations, live-run artifact roots, and worktree recovery state need Orchestrator/SCM registration
Worktree visibility is only partially wired between Source Control and Orchestrator — the interface contract between these two surfaces must be fully defined
Settings scopes are too coarse — global/project toggles exist but package/seam/lane/run/account-aware policy scopes are mostly absent and must be added
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Layout blocker: packetization/repair needed for orchestrator-facing layout fidelity.
